protocol: prereg step 4: 25 post-phrasing criteria pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet-class auditor sees only the blinded file; disputes adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter; 2 planted probe pairs per round

members.name: Identifies a specific analytical error in the agency's own analysis
Bare mention of the phrase 'cost-benefit analysis'
States who would be affected and how, with concrete detail

final.name: Professional regulatory drafting
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores drafting register and apparatus as a surface feature and disclaims scoring whether the positions taken are sound; this is a professional-drafting fingerprint, not substance.

final.name: Reads as a graded course assignment rather than a stakeholder filing
final.audit_justification: Scores genre/shape markers (assignment framing, five-paragraph structure, hedged verbs, general-audience citations) rather than what the comment establishes; a purely shape-based instruction is incidental even where it correlates with merit.

final.name: Implementation burden realism
final.audit_justification: Requires concrete staffing/timing/equipment/workflow/cost constraints tied to implementation, which is substantive feasibility analysis a regulatory analyst would value.

final.name: Identifies a specific analytical error in the agency's own analysis
final.audit_justification: Requires pointing to a specific step, assumption, figure, or table in the agency's analysis and explaining a concrete defect -- direct engagement with the agency's reasoning.

final.name: Comparative tradeoff analysis
final.audit_justification: Requires weighing plausible alternatives against one another with stated advantages/disadvantages -- substantive comparative analysis, not a surface proxy.

final.name: Differentiated identification of affected stakeholder groups
final.audit_justification: Requires naming at least two distinct affected groups and explaining how effects differ between them; this is substantive differentiated impact analysis.

final.name: Compliance feasibility grounded in how the work is done
final.audit_justification: Requires walking through the real sequence of work, access constraints, staffing, or timing to evaluate feasibility -- concrete operational knowledge, explicitly scored over rhetorical force.

final.name: Scanned/faxed physical-document artifacts (OCR noise, stamps)
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a surface-format feature (OCR garbling, stamps, transmission artifacts) unrelated to argument content.

final.name: Substance survives deletion of the position statement
final.audit_justification: Tests whether, after stripping position/attitude/procedural language, a body of reasons, facts, or requested changes remains -- a direct test for substantive regulatory content.

final.name: Monitoring and verification design
final.audit_justification: Requires a concrete, measurable monitoring/testing/reporting mechanism to assess whether the regulatory approach functions -- substantive actionable proposal content.

final.name: Bare mention of the phrase 'cost-benefit analysis'
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a bare word/phrase-presence check that disclaims considering whether the comment actually engages with any analysis.

final.name: Detail-level concreteness of any proposed alternative
final.audit_justification: Requires the alternative's mechanism -- steps, components, numbers, procedure -- to be specified in enough detail for another reader to implement or evaluate it; this is an actionable-alternative merit criterion.

final.name: Causal mechanism linking action to stated goal
final.audit_justification: Requires an explicit causal chain ('X causes Y because Z') specific enough to evaluate the logic, as opposed to a bare value statement -- substantive analytical content.

final.name: States who would be affected and how, with concrete detail
final.audit_justification: Requires naming the specific population/firms/operations affected and describing concretely what would change for them -- substantive, specific impact analysis.

final.name: Engages a named provision, alternative, or solicited question
final.audit_justification: Requires both pinpointing a specific provision/alternative/question and giving a locatable reason or answer -- specificity about the rule combined with engagement with the agency's reasoning.

final.name: Temporal and cumulative effects
final.audit_justification: Requires reasoning about delayed, repeated, cumulative, or long-term effects rather than only immediate impact -- substantive analytical depth about consequences.

final.name: Quantified scale of real-world impact
final.audit_justification: Requires concrete, comment-specific figures establishing the magnitude of the problem or benefit -- evidentiary content, not a borrowed or generic statistic.

final.name: Concrete distributional effects
final.audit_justification: Requires naming a specific group, describing its exposure/access pathway, and connecting that pathway to a particular regulatory choice -- substantive distributional analysis.

final.name: Verifiable, attributable evidentiary sourcing
final.audit_justification: Requires citations to named studies, agency data, statutes, or reports that actually support the claim made -- verifiable evidentiary grounding, a core merit dimension.

final.name: Numbered or bulleted list formatting
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a surface-formatting check (presence of list markers) that instructs the judge never to consider the content of the items.

final.name: First-hand local exposure
final.audit_justification: A 10 can be earned by bare identity/standing facts alone (personal residence or occupation 'tied to the proposal') with no analysis, evidence, or claim about the rule's effects -- it is closer to a submitter-identity/standing marker than to the substantive content the first-hand-knowledge sense of quality-relevance implies; a comment saying only 'I live nearby, please deny this' would score high while saying nothing substantive.

final.name: OCR and attachment provenance
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a surface-format feature (document-wrapper language, duplicated covers, OCR corruption, filing residue) scored apart from the substance around it.

final.name: Pseudo-quantified authority
final.audit_justification: Scores the density of piled-up statistics, dollar amounts, named reports, or links as rhetorical accumulation, explicitly disclaiming whether the material is accurate or well used -- so a comment could pile up irrelevant or unsupportive figures and score high, making this a shape/rhetorical-authority marker rather than a measure of what the evidence establishes.

final.name: Credentialed insider self-positioning
final.audit_justification: Scores prominence of self-asserted credentials/role/experience, explicitly disclaiming whether the credential is verified or relevant -- a submitter-identity fingerprint, not substantive content.

final.name: Coordinated campaign residue
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a surface textual marker (repeated campaign phrasing, slogans, standardized calls to action) scored apart from the merit or sincerity of the comment -- a boilerplate/template-similarity marker.
